label: Poe (Quora)
terms_note: Bots REST API open to any creator with a Poe API key (poe.com/api/keys); creator monetization needs Stripe, one of 23 eligible countries, tax info within 90 days, $10 payout threshold paid 30-45 days after month end; per-message pricing US-only, per-token pricing for API bots; no rate limit published for the Bots API (inference API: 500 req/min); fraud / inauthentic engagement forfeits earnings.
official_mcp: https://github.com/n0madic/poe-mcp (community; calls Poe bots, not creation)

reference.verdict: **Verdict**: has_api **yes** (API bots), UI-only for server-bot creation.
auth: 1. Tenant creates a Poe API key at `https://poe.com/api/keys` (Poe subscription required for the key).
3. To earn: join the Creator Monetization Program (Stripe as Payment Agent, 23 countries, tax info within 90 days).

endpoints.notes: responses_api, max_input_tokens, context_size, input_modalities[text,image,video], output_modalities[text], supported_features["tools"], pricing{prompt, completion, input_cache_reads, context_pricing[]}, param_definitions}`, `parameter_controls` → `{"edit_bot_status":"success"}`

endpoints.purpose: same fields, merge semantics ("only the provided fields are updated"); set `is_private:false` to publish, `pricing` to re-price

endpoints.call: **none** in the public API — earnings in the Creator dashboard

reference.limits: Bots API: none published. Inference API: 500 requests / minute (`x-ratelimit-remaining-requests`, `x-ratelimit-reset-requests`). - Automation of API-bot creation is the documented path ("You can create and manage API Bots using the Bots REST API"). - Earnings: $10 payout threshold, paid via Stripe 30–45 days after month end; price-per-message capped at $10,000 per 1,000 messages and US-only; fraud / inauthentic engagement forfeits earnings; Quora may terminate without cause. - Private bots are not reachable through the external OpenAI-compatible API.
mcp_sdk: Community MCP servers call Poe bots (https://github.com/n0madic/poe-mcp) — they do not create bots. No official MCP.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists the key owner's API bots.

list_products.note: GET https://api.poe.com/bots ('None' query parameters) lists the creator's API bots in one response (page/limit ignored). id and name are the bot handle; price is not mapped: pricing is api_bot_settings.pricing {prompt, completion}, string dollar amounts PER TOKEN (in raw). is_private, model_name, base_url and api_type are in raw.

not_offered.get_product: No GET /bots/{handle} is documented; list_products returns every bot's full record.
not_offered.create_product: POST /bots needs handle plus api_bot_settings {model_name, base_url, api_key, api_type} of the upstream model server (https://creator.poe.com/api-reference/createBot); a name/price/currency product cannot express it.
not_offered.update_price: Bot pricing is two per-token dollar strings (pricing {prompt, completion}) set by PATCH /bots/{handle}; a single major-unit price per product has no faithful mapping.
not_offered.list_sales: No sales endpoint: 'earnings' are shown on the Creators page / help centre only (https://creator.poe.com/docs/resources/creator-monetization).
not_offered.get_sales_stats: Earnings are dashboard-only (creator-monetization page); no stats endpoint.
not_offered.list_refunds: No refunds concept or endpoint in the Bots API.
not_offered.refund: No refunds concept or endpoint in the Bots API.

evidence: host api.poe.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 403 (blocked), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check: the docs pages did not render (login wall, SPA or bot wall)
